prompt: An assistant should check calendars, find a free slot and send the meeting invite on its own.
tells: send the meeting invite on its own
why: Taking actions with tools to finish a task is an agent.
trap: RAG only reads information; this changes things.

prompt: In the Foundry portal, a chatbot is given a function that can issue refunds, and decides when to call it.
why: A model choosing to call tools is an agent.
trap: A system prompt alone can't take actions.

prompt: Given a question, the assistant searches the web, runs code to analyze what it found, and repeats until it can answer.
why: Planning, using tools and looping is agent behavior.
trap: A reasoning model thinks; an agent also acts.

prompt: Build one assistant with instructions, a file-search tool and a code interpreter, then test it in the portal's playground.
tells: a file-search tool and a code interpreter
why: Instructions plus tools is a single-agent solution in Foundry Agent Service.
trap: File search is one tool here; the solution is an agent.

prompt: An assistant should look up an order, check stock in another system, and create a replacement shipment if needed.
tells: create a replacement shipment if needed
why: Calling several systems and acting is agent work.
trap: RAG would only read; this changes data.

prompt: A small Python app sends a user's message to an agent built in the Foundry portal and prints the agent's reply.
tells: sends a user's message to an agent built in the Foundry portal
why: A lightweight client application for an agent calls it through the Foundry SDK.
trap: The client calls an agent, not just a model with a system prompt.

prompt: An HR assistant should submit a vacation request in the HR system when an employee asks for time off.
why: Taking an action in another system is what an agent does.
trap: Reading the policy would be RAG; submitting the request is an action.

prompt: A user uploads a spreadsheet and asks for a chart of monthly sales. The assistant writes and runs Python to make it.
tells: writes and runs Python to make it
why: An agent with the code interpreter tool can run code to finish a task.
trap: Reasoning alone can't produce a chart file.
